ValidationRule.description: Venkat: Implemented for Emission Factor Auto population. Purpose: When a Site Information Record is created with country 'US', then the state needs to be populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Country , "US"), OR( ISBLANK(State), LEN(State) <> 2, NOT(CONTAINS( $Label.NZC_US_Country_State_Codes , State)), CONTAINS (State,';') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the valid 2 character State Code if Country entered is US
